channel.description: Latest articles from The Lawrence Times (lawrencekstimes.com)

item.title: Construction on Bob Billings to reduce road to one lane for multiple blocks
item.description: Starting Monday, a construction project will reduce traffic on Bob Billings Parkway to one lane in each direction between Monterey Way and Kasold Drive. The city expects the work to take a year. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Holiday Homes Tour, benefiting Habitat for Humanity, to return
item.description: An annual holiday homes tour that helps fund a nonprofit's efforts to create affordable housing is coming up Sunday, Dec. 7. Continue reading ...

item.title: City study on North Lawrence corridor, Grant Township to progress with open house, survey
item.description: A city team is planning an open house to present the findings of last month's North Lawrence corridor visioning session. The project also encompasses tracts of land from unincorporated Grant Township. Continue reading ...

item.title: Participants in Lawrence debate on affordable housing all want to see people housed, but the ‘how’ is complicated
item.description: A city co-sponsored debate on affordable housing was not a forum for steel to meet steel, but for community members to question how the city, county and community could ensure more people can afford to be housed. Continue reading ...

item.title: Group of KU faculty, staff and students to perform fall concert
item.description: The Bales Choral Society, a group of KU faculty, staff members and students from various departments and disciplines across campus, are set to perform a fall concert. Continue reading ...

item.title: City of Lawrence consultants to host conversations about housing as part of study
item.description: The City of Lawrence is asking community members to provide consultants with input about affordable housing and the community's housing needs for a study in progress. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence High students win awards at 2D and 3D art competition
item.description: Four Lawrence High School students won top awards at a major art competition in Merriam this week. Continue reading ...

item.title: Organizations earn grant for exhibit to be spread across 6 Douglas County sites
item.description: Douglas County museums have earned a grant that will support an exhibition to be displayed across six historic sites throughout the county. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence school board to consider approving LHS fire repairs, hear report on class sizes
item.description: The Lawrence school board on Monday will consider approving a $142,393 expense to repair damages from a fire in a Lawrence High School locker room. Continue reading ...

item.title: Prairie Moon Waldorf School’s Winter Light Faire to return (Sponsored post)
item.description: Those who attend Prairie Moon Waldorf School's annual Winter Light Faire can meet Queen Winter in her secret snowy kingdom, hand-dip beeswax candles, make a fairy house or gnome home and more. Continue reading ...
